Comments: All Accelerator builds have the same goal of "how many rockets can i shoot". This build is the basic implementation of that. Just raw damage increase and volume.

The requeening build ends up fun but not a showstopper. Since we now have the tools to make this build work it can stretch its legs. Unfortunately its just not as good scaling as just stacking more speed multipliers.

This build sacrifices volume of missiles for a very heavy missile. It functions pretty alright in bossing, but id wonder if it even really works in horde clear due to the nature of how it reloads. If you miss too many bullets you just fail to be able to regenerate your ammo.

The problem with utilizing the Beam Ripper within the game is that there is just better options. You will be heavy swapping repeatedly trying to deal enough damage to kill. Especially with Inverted Spear of Hell removing pierce.
This Beam Ripper build fares better against the Amalgamation but we are still in the land where we are constantly heavy swapping with an insane amount of downtime.
While the Carver is very middling in bossing, this weapon actually is very solid now with Turkey's Bloodlust. That being said, in Amalgamation Hunt, just dont bring it.
The weaker overall version of the cycler, it struggles harder with healing and damage since it requires more overall space to accomplish its natural goal. So we miss out on some basic upgrades.

Infinity Burn will go down as the most safe build you can go while also not being strong. It gets the job done eventually. But, since the Cycler isnt a very powerful weapon it gets downgraded to relying on Internal Combustion in order to function.

Diffraction Driver is nowhere near the top of the power charts, but it is a solid weapon. Its ceiling isnt that great but it, much like the Cycler, relies on Internal Combustion to offset its lack of damage.

This build is a little different. Since it is a cryo build and we dont have many on the list, it having Snowball means that a lot of our damage is actually coming from Shardburst. Its not horrible as a concept, but is very specifically ok, since the Snowball lacks healing options.

Pocket Sniper as a concept baffles me for being both a solid idea and a weak implementation. Overall it deals more damage so it can kill the Amalgamation fairly quickly so theres no denying its power. Just dont expect it to win any awards for horde clear.
This thing rips through bosses, it will never be as fast as bypassing shells, but it will slaughter. The simplest build to execute since it is purely hold the fire button.

Concussive Wave has gone through some different build iterations where im not happy with any of them. You can make it have strong single target (still slow) or have it be really slow to kill but have AoE. Neither make me happy and it just sits in no mans land.
Globbler is an exceptional weapon all around. It wins on all fronts that this game promotes. It brings the damage and AoE in which will bypass all challenge to the game.
I want to love this build, but it is just so much weaker than i would want. Mostly due to the lack of tools within the Globblers upgrades for this build.

Hull Piercer is an insane upgrade. You "sacrifice" the ability to have a magazine for 1 big shot. Increasing every statistic in the book at once (minus fire rate). Its no wonder that when given tools to mitigate the downsides that it just ends up going crazy.

Lagrange Halo is one of my personal favorite upgrades. its certainly not good, but, i love it. Since this upgrade nukes all AoE from the projectile, we opt into going point demolition and thumper to really maximize the tradeoff.
Similar to the Lagrange Halo build, this build is more of the what if category. Hull Piercer is king, but this build sits to test how much better the strategy is at bossing.
The bossing king, slideshot is just too easy to abuse. As long as you are in the air, continue to tap slide to get more slideshots. Ghosting is just a mandetory upgrade to make the weapon function.
The flamethrower build is not great. it doesnt have enough things to build around to help it survive. Its upside is that it is a cylinder projection, meaning we just hit core always.

There is 2 ways to utilize this build, the default way of charging Pummeler, which is the intended way. Or the bugged way of rebinding reload to fire to constantly gain the fire rate without charging. Sadly, this means the stronger build (double barrel) will just win that race until the bug is fixed.
Laser cannon is hands down the best heavy weapon in the game. It doesnt even require its full battery to delete bosses, so your refire onto another target is instant.
Dont pick up this weapon.

I have spent much time pondering this build. But it comes down to the fact that we are simply at a point where this weapon is now viable. You can choose not to include the Feeling Lucky upgrade, but since it skews toward over 100% damage its worth taking.
I have little love for this style, but it is what the people want. Thus here it is, the non Doobie build, that still functions exactly the same.
The Photon Disc as a main weapon is certainly formidable. I think i could improve this build, but for now this is its standing.
The classic DoToo build. The charm behind it is clear, just keep shooting the Plate Launcher, dont worry about the extra fluff.

The true original. BiblicallyAccuratePlateLauncher's build that revolutionized the Plate Launcher (though his had decay instead of shock). It does it all, stick them in with Fencing Construction, hit them with other projectiles for Damage Arc, continually shoot with Salad Plates.

The most interesting Plate Launcher build, Vector Interdiction is fun for the sake of it. Its not the strongest build in the game, but it will atleast be fun to look at since it isnt just a bullet hose.
The melee variant of the Shocklance and oddly enough the best boss destroyer. This build is about launching yourself into the enemy.
The standard Shocklance build. My build here does not include Micro Detonators which would be the true horde clear power, but this is about boss killing.
The sniper build for the Shocklance. Realistically this fails to deliver on both damage and clear so it just sits in the no mans land of everyone is upset.
Solid option if you need a heavy, not the best, but certainly wont disappoint. Its low range requires you to barrel stuff.

Conversion of the Swarm Launcher from an alt fire to a straight fire weapon completely changes the game in terms of consistency. This build is essentially the baseline dps. The only issue with Swarm Launcher is that in testing i cannot use the Swarm Launcher for ammo generation (which causes time loss).

Mitosis is one of the fun builds of the game, so it does have some extra perks over the Guidance Array style. It allows for the ability to hover a massive magazine above a boss and crash it down onto them for a one shot. The only issue with Swarm Launcher is that in testing i cannot use the Swarm Launcher for ammo generation (which causes time loss).

Utilizing Gunpowder Finale is rough on this weapon, but it is possible. While we cannot lower our magazine size we can use Broadside to double our ammo used per trigger pull. This build is entirely a bossing build since taking the Globbler with our build makes it entirely impossible to use in a normal mission.
This build focuses around the aiming damage buffs from Lone Cannoneer and the Globblers ability to Corrode us. On top of abusing the current bug with Plasma.
The true build of the Trident, it is the only of the 3 that actually is usable in normal missions. but in return it loses some features.
